تعلوطن (form XIII)
# تَعْلَوِّطْنَ (taʕlawwiṭna) /taʕ.law.witˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# تُعْلَوَّطْنَ (tuʕlawwaṭna) /tuʕ.law.watˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
